log.notes_to_self: STRATEGY. Caught = pool <=1000 at end of a day. Routine: put all quick kills in the AFTERNOON only. That rules out day workers, so pool = 55000. Never put more than 2 deaths in the morning, or students are ruled out too. Of my 5 places, exactly 2 are unreachable for L and 3 are reachable. A traced victim from an unreachable place always fails. Hidden extra places are never among my own places. If all 3 reachable places get triggered (3 successful traces each), pool is about 55000*0.25*0.25*0.2, under 1000, so I am caught. If only 2 trigger, pool is at least 2750, so I am safe. PLAN: find ONE reachable place that has at most 2 successful traces, then PROTECT it (never kill its victims again). After that, kill all other victims: national + 4 places x2 = 9 per day. 9 a day keeps the 4x multiplier going (needs 40 in 5 days). TEST METHOD: kill 5 or fewer per day so every death is traced. The rise in deaths_traced then equals the successful traces (national victims don't count). If a tested place gives a rise of 1 or more, it is reachable: protect it. If the rise is 0, it is unreachable (about 98% sure). Test order: blotter first (best to protect, factor 0.2), then clips. If both are unreachable, then East, forum and foreign are all reachable: protect East. Places already shown unreachable can be added to test days, since they never add successes. DAY 1: tested blotter (d1-5, d1-7) plus national d1-2. Used 2 quick afternoon + 1 timed evening, so routine is still hidden. deaths_traced before day 1 = 0. Day 2: if deaths_traced is 1 or more, blotter is reachable: PROTECT blotter and kill all other 9 (quick afternoon, 10 max; any 11th as timed afternoon). If deaths_traced is 0, blotter is unreachable: test clips x2 + blotter x2 + national (5 deaths, all traced).

Pool history: day 0 100000, day 1 100000 (traced 2).
